name: markouts
about: Markouts of fills: the mid a fixed time after each fill, signed so positive means the fill made money (buy: later mid above the fill price; sell: below). A live tracker fed with the clock and the mid, a lookup in a recorded mid series, and size-weighted averages by side and horizon.
offers: signed(side, price, later_mid) -> price difference in the fill's favour
Tracker(horizons=HORIZONS): .add(fill_dict with side, price, local_ns); .advance(now_ns, mid) -> finished rows (the fill plus mid<h> and m<h> per horizon, None when no mid); .pending
from_series(times_ns, mids, fill, horizons=HORIZONS, max_age_ns=10e9) -> the same row from a sorted recorded series, or None when the series ends before the last horizon
summary(rows, horizons=HORIZONS) -> {buy|sell|all: {h: {avg, avg_bps, n, size}}}, weighted by fill size
